description: This file defines the CustomerDAO interface, which extends a generic DAO and provides methods for retrieving Customer entities based on various criteria within the sales management application.

classes.name: CustomerDAO
classes.description: Interface for customer data access operations, extending a generic DAO interface and adding customer-specific query methods.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customers matching the specified name.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customers associated with the specified merchant store.

methods.name: getByNick
methods.description: Fetches a customer using their nickname.

methods.name: listByStore
